simulation.numeric_parameters_are: hypothetical engineering assumptions; not real estimated statistics
simulation.channel_acceptance: PLATFORM uses last visible cached stock; OTHER uses atomic current PMS stock
simulation.outage_process: At 08:00 daily, draw an outage only if no outage is active; it blocks hotel HTTP and PMS delivery until end time.
simulation.transport_lost_message_policy: A silently dropped initial job is discovered by reconfirmation; do not pretend it was acknowledged by the PMS.
simulation.cancellation_time_policy: If selected, choose a uniform second between confirmation+1 second and check-in-1 second; channel/PMS release is an event, not a retroactive edit.

inventory_probes.observed_value: supplier visible cached stock, never private physical stock

reconfirmation.late_confirmed_policy: send at confirmation if after the regular scheduled check

manual_recovery.trigger: expired reconfirmation deadline or hotel not-found
manual_recovery.queue_order: earliest check-in date, request time, booking ID; carry unfinished tasks forward
manual_recovery.failed_contact_policy: same task carried to next day until final recovery deadline

simulation.cache_confirmation_transaction: Atomic full-stay check and decrement of cached rooms
simulation.cache_refresh_policy: Replace cached stock from current PMS free stock; pending/lost supplier commitments are not known by PMS and may be overwritten
simulation.scheduled_action_guard: Do not newly reserve after cancellation, no-show or terminal failure; release once; no resurrection after arrival+2h
simulation.atomic_rejection_night_policy: Earliest blocking night evidenced unavailable; other unattempted nights UNKNOWN/NOT_ATTEMPTED; no later original stay attempts after terminal rejection
simulation.buffer_policy: Generate confirmations for future arrivals through last target+max lead, process events only until simulation.end; buffer arrivals are never 2025 evaluation rows.
simulation.booking_request_time_policy: check_in_date - lead_days, plus uniform integer second in 0..86399 local time
simulation.pms_ack_idempotency: same booking/message ID returns prior reservation without another room decrement
simulation.cancellation_inventory_release: release protected PMS nights once; refresh visible platform stock from current PMS snapshot instead of adding both cancellation and snapshot deltas
simulation.evidence_drop_scope: Persistent loss of the source evidence-emission/outbox job at physical outcome time; logged mechanism, not per-poll label masking. Existing evidence can be collected after transient outage recovery.

pastFailureRate90d.denominator: booking-level known outcomes available by as_of

reconfirmationOverdueRate7d.request_start: first platform registered/sent request, including requests receiving errors

labels.cohort: PLATFORM bookings CONFIRMED and not observed cancelled at as_of, fixed then
labels.booking_positive: one or more finally unfulfilled original nights with collected valid evidence
labels.booking_negative: all required original nights fulfilled and collected evidence complete
labels.hotel_day_negative: nonempty fixed cohort and every member is negative
labels.unknown: otherwise; includes unverifiable cancellation/no-show and missing evidence
labels.semantic_correction_scope: No false final evidence or post-hoc semantic retractions in v0.2. Versioned as-of adjudication required before adding those scenarios.

evaluation.threshold_selection: validation F1; tie: higher precision, then higher threshold
evaluation.importance: validation permutation importance and pastFailureRate90d ablation; no enforced rank
evaluation.final_model_policy: Use selected Apr-Sep-trained checkpoint; no train+validation refit in v0.2

future_work: This file declares rules; no simulator, dataset or trained model is completed by its creation.
